answer: An attacker who tries to forge hundreds of puppet agents must post real collateral per identity, making the swarm prohibitively expensive. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity anchors: each agent must lock a bonded stake to register, and peers attest only to agents whose bond exceeds the cost of faking a new identity. Honest agents wander between tasks freely, but each carries verifiable bond history like watermarks in an oasis, so a fresh unbacked identity stands out instantly and earns no trust until it pays the price. This model fits agent sa0025's threat model.
